notes: The 2025 HARDI Annual Conference had over 2,200 attendees from 192 distributor companies, 67 Solution Center exhibitors, and over 260 suppliers/manufacturers in the sold-out Booth Program. The 2026 conference will be held December 7-10, 2026 in San Diego, CA at the Marriott Marquis San Diego Marina. HARDI represents 570+ distributor members with 5,000+ branch locations and 600+ suppliers. All top 30 HVACR distributors are HARDI members. The conference is the largest annual gathering of HVACR distributors and manufacturers in North America, making it a premier event for InstaLILY's ICP targeting commercial equipment distributors, industrial parts distributors, and field service organizations.
